# Balance mod: the game's file, copied whole, with only the colony window's
# building lock added to each type's can_destroy (balance_building_not_kept).
# Generated by write_building_locks.py -- rerun it after every game update.
hre_imperial_armory_foreign = {
	allow = { balance_building_not_forbidden = { TYPE = hre_imperial_armory_foreign } }	# Balance mod: colony window build priorities
	audio_tier = 3
	is_foreign = yes
	pop_type = soldiers
	max_levels = hre_imperial_armory_max_level
	international_organization_link = hre
	category = military_category
	forbidden_for_estates = yes
	employment_size = manpower_employment
	pop_size_created = manpower_employment
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes
	price = hre_army_building
	build_time = medium_soldier_building
	convert_on_ownership = hre_imperial_armory_own	
	location_potential = {
		is_owned_by_international_organization = international_organization:hre
		OR = {
			rank_index >= 1
			is_capital = yes
		}
	}
	country_potential = {
		is_emperor = yes
	}
	international_organization_potential = {
		international_organization_has_law = law:military_contribution
		NOT = { international_organization_has_policy = policy:no_military_contribution }
	}
	modifier = {
		manpower_to_building_owner = 0.005
	}
	possible_production_methods =  {
		early_soldier_building_maintenance
	}
	remove_if = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { exists = international_organization:hre }
			location ?= { NOT = { is_owned_by_international_organization = international_organization:hre } }
		}
		trigger_else = { always = yes }
	}
	construction_demand = early_soldier_building_construction
	can_destroy = { balance_building_not_kept = yes  # Balance mod: colony window building lock
	}
}
hre_imperial_armory_own = {
	allow = { balance_building_not_forbidden = { TYPE = hre_imperial_armory_own } }	# Balance mod: colony window build priorities
	audio_tier = 3
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = soldiers
	max_levels = hre_imperial_armory_max_level
	international_organization_link = hre
	category = military_category
	forbidden_for_estates = yes
	employment_size = manpower_employment
	town = yes
	city = yes
	megalopolis = yes

	price = hre_army_building
	
	build_time = medium_soldier_building
	convert_on_ownership = hre_imperial_armory_foreign	
	location_potential = {
		is_owned_by_international_organization = international_organization:hre
		OR = {
			rank_index >= 1
			is_capital = yes
		}
	}
	country_potential = {
		is_emperor = yes
	}
	international_organization_potential = {
		international_organization_has_law = law:military_contribution
		NOT = { international_organization_has_policy = policy:no_military_contribution }
	}
	modifier = {
		local_manpower = 0.0025
		can_recruit_regiment_in_this_location = yes
	}
	possible_production_methods =  {
		early_soldier_building_maintenance
	}
	remove_if = {
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { exists = international_organization:hre }
			location ?= { NOT = { is_owned_by_international_organization = international_organization:hre } }
		}
		trigger_else = { always = yes }
	}
	construction_demand = early_soldier_building_construction
	can_destroy = { balance_building_not_kept = yes  # Balance mod: colony window building lock
	}
}
